object: Symmetrical bracket or bookend with flared top and bottom feet

views.constrains: XZ profile (width and height), defining the flared feet and central waist
YZ profile (depth and height), defining the flared feet and central waist

parts.description: Single solid body with flared top and bottom sections and a narrower central waist

features.description: Horizontal flared section at the top of the object
Horizontal flared section at the bottom of the object
Narrower vertical section connecting top and bottom flanges

relations.description: Top and bottom flanges are symmetrical about the horizontal centerline
Left and right sides are symmetrical about the vertical centerline

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: Exact thickness of the central waist relative to the flanges
Whether the flanges are perfectly flat or have slight curvature
generation_notes: The object is interpreted as a single solid part based on the two orthographic views. The front view shows the width and height profile, while the right view shows the depth and height profile. Both views share the same height and show a similar 'I' or 'H' shape with flared ends. The geometry is regularized to be symmetrical.

unresolved_constraints: Exact depth value needs to be scaled from view_2 relative to max_dimension

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
